column1: The following applies to all the above trays:
Check for correct tray material of construction.
Check proper routing, different types (see above) and correct separations.
Check cable tray grounding (continuous 4/0 bare copper conductors, ground clips to trays and final connection on both ends to ground grid).
Check cable fill in tray for less than maximum permitted by code.
Check proper supports and maximum spans.
Check cable strapping to trays by UV rated tie-wraps (or equal) minimum support distance every 3’-0” (1 m).
